gloss: deep in the mountains, remote mountain area

definitions.gloss: deep in the mountains, remote mountain area
definitions.explanation: A place far into the mountains, typically remote and difficult to access. Implies seclusion and distance from civilization.

examples.japanese: {山奥|やまおく}に{温泉|おんせん}がある。
examples.english: There is a hot spring deep in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {山奥|やまおく}の{村|むら}には{店|みせ}が{一|ひと}つもない。
examples.english: The village deep in the mountains doesn't have a single shop.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{山奥|やまおく}で{一人|ひとり}{暮|く}らしをしていて、{買|か}い{物|もの}に{行|い}くだけでも{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: My grandfather lives alone deep in the mountains, and even just going shopping is a challenge.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {山|やま} (mountain) and {奥|おく} (interior, deep part). Emphasizes remoteness and seclusion more than {山|やま} alone. Often used to describe locations where traditional ways of life persist or where nature remains untouched.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山奥|やまおく}の{村|むら}: mountain village deep in the mountains
- {山奥|やまおく}に{住|す}む: to live deep in the mountains
- {山奥|やまおく}に{分|わ}け{入|い}る: to venture deep into the mountains
- {山奥|やまおく}の{温泉|おんせん}: hot spring deep in the mountains
